pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 22809-22823 (label lemma-base-change-NL-flat, canonical tag 0FJU): for a cocartesian square of rings with the algebra flat over the base, the base change of its naive cotangent complex is a quasi-isomorphism onto the naive cotangent complex of the base changed algebra, and the derived base change is one too when the naive cotangent complex has tor amplitude in the interval from minus one to zero. The proof environment at source lines 22825-22853 immediately follows it and is its own proof: it chooses a polynomial presentation, uses flatness to identify the kernels of the two presentations and hence the conormal modules, compares the modules of differentials to get an isomorphism of complexes, and observes that the tor amplitude hypothesis is exactly flatness of the conormal module, which makes the ordinary and derived base changes agree.
